task: Background worker architecture for order state tracking. Distributed workers track and log order state transitions so the customer portal shows accurate real-time status.
checklist: Workers listen to state transition events (Created -> Picked -> Shipped)
Logs are aggregated with a retry mechanism for failed database writes
Customer portal API reads the latest state with < 1s latency
Negative: unknown/out-of-order event -> rejected or queued, not silently applied
Edge: worker crashes mid-transition -> retry does not create a duplicate state entry (idempotency)
Edge: two workers process the same order concurrently -> last-write-wins rule is explicit and correct
Failed DB write after N retries -> alert is raised, event is not silently dropped
Audit: every state transition is timestamped and traceable to the triggering event
